 Follow Kevin Bacon pleads for help after suffering heartbreaking personal loss — watch emotional new video
 Tess Hill Fri, October 16, 2026 at 8:35 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Kevin Bacon needs your help. The Footloose actor took to social media on Friday, October 16 to share the harrowing story his clothes have been on for almost a month, which you can watch above.
 Kevin, 68, is working in Ireland and instead of traveling with several pieces of luggage, decided to ship some of his favorite items of clothing to The Emerald Isle instead. Unfortunately for the actor, his clothes have still not arrived.
 Kevin and Kyra traveled to Spain where their new film "Family Movie" was being shown (@ Getty Images)
 Seated in front of an ocean sunset, Kevin spoke to the camera telling the tale of his missing clothes that he's had "since the '90s." He shared his beloved clothes that were shipped out on September 26 were mistakenly sent to Israel instead of Ireland – not once, but three times.

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Nearly a month later, Kevin's clothes are finally in Ireland, but he has still not received them. "On October 11th, [the package] left the UK and came straight to Ireland, where it has been sitting for five days and they say they're unable to deliver it."
 The couple starred in Family Movie alongside their children Travis and Sosie (@ Getty Images)
 He acknowledged that he – who is worth some $45 million with his wife of over 35 years, actress Kyra Sedgwick – could go purchase new clothes. "I could buy some clothes, but I want these clothes," Kevin admitted, adding: "I've had them since the '90s. They have a certain sentimental value."
 Kevin, please know that all of us at HELLO! are with you and hope that your clothes are delivered as soon as possible!
